learning_outcomes.text: Apply and implement methods for the analysis of mechanics and aerodynamics.
Develop a design project from detailed plan to a working 'proof of concept' model.
Examine and implement time-planning and scheduling in manufacture and assembly.
Examine the process of design iteration and optimisation.

syllabus_topics: Build of design from ME316 Design 3A
Test of design from ME316 Design 3A
Optimisation of design from ME316 Design 3A

assessment_methods.method: First Operational sub-systems demonstration and interim presentation (Week 5)

assessment_rules: Students must gain a summative mark of 40% to pass the module. For resit, students who fail at the first attempt will be re-assessed prior to the July/August exam diet. This re-assessment will consist entirely of a coursework, and no marks from previous attempts will be transferred. Peer assessment will be applied to the group assignment, combining staff grade with students' weighted contribution.
